BACKSTAGE
THE IDEA TO TAKE AWAY

Context tells the agent something.
An ontology defines what that something means.

Tools still do the work. The ontology gives them shared objects, relationships and action contracts. Authentication, permissions, freshness checks and reliable execution still need to be implemented and enforced.
